rationale: The agent properly verified the user via full name and ZIP, matched to a single account, and only acted on that account. It checked the relevant pending order, correctly noted that exchanges apply post-delivery, and appropriately offered a modification for the pending order instead. The agent consulted product details, identified a suitable waterproof, highest-resolution-in-stock option within the prior price, and requested explicit confirmation before performing any write. Upon confirmation, it executed the modification with correct item IDs, calculated and issued the correct refund amount, and reported the updated order status. Minor extra statements (e.g., refund timeline and no-further-changes note) were not contradicted by tool outputs, and the core actions complied with policy. Therefore, the request was completed in line with policy.
